tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Fathom by night, Paper by day.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and the review modal, on ground.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Code blocks, wells and empty states.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Decorative: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and focus rings. 3:1 or more on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body on ground, surface or surface-sunk (10.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, timestamps (5.6:1 or more on ground and surface).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and quiet actions (4.8:1 or more on ground and surface).

tokens.name: beacon
tokens.usage: The slip. Drift signal, drift highlights and the Possibly stale badge. One per view: primary buttons fill with text instead. Text on it uses on-beacon. Never text on Day grounds.

tokens.name: on-beacon
tokens.usage: Text and icons on beacon (8.8:1).

tokens.name: beacon-text
tokens.usage: Amber as text or an icon on ground or surface (6.3:1 by day, 8.8:1 by night).

tokens.name: trace
tokens.usage: The trace: a fill at the position content should hold. Fills only, never text.

tokens.name: verified
tokens.usage: Verified badge text and icon, on verified-tint.

tokens.name: verified-tint
tokens.usage: Verified badge fill.

tokens.name: stale
tokens.usage: Stale badge text and icon, on stale-tint.

tokens.name: stale-tint
tokens.usage: Stale badge fill.

tokens.name: unanchored
tokens.usage: Unanchored badge text and icon, on unanchored-tint.

tokens.name: unanchored-tint
tokens.usage: Unanchored badge fill.

tokens.name: fathom
tokens.usage: Brand ink, the deepest teal. Logo tile base, Night shift ground.

tokens.name: shoal
tokens.usage: Brand teal. Logo tile top, dark surfaces in marketing.

tokens.name: current
tokens.usage: Brand mid teal for illustration, charts and tide lines. Never text.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand light. Day ground and the mark on dark grounds.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Brand light tint for lines and light illustration.

tokens.name: beacon-high
tokens.usage: Top stop of the slip gradient. Logo and hero art only.

tokens.name: beacon-low
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the slip gradient. Logo and hero art only.
